title: Samsung Electronics 2026 second-quarter earnings results
excerpt: Second-quarter revenue was KRW 171.5 trillion, operating profit KRW 89.5 trillion, net profit KRW 71.6 trillion, and preferred-share EPS KRW 10,899.
summary: The unchanged Q2 issuer results remain the latest detailed operating baseline: record memory performance and net financial strength coexist with weak Device eXperience profitability, cyclicality and instrument-level valuation gaps.
